header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ رَافِعٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ غَسَلَ مَيِّتًا فَكَتَمَ عَلَيْهِ غُفِرَ لَهُ اَرْبَعِيْنَ مَرَّةً، وَمَنْ كَفَّنَ مَيِّتًا كَسَاهُ اللهُ مِنَ السُّنْدُسِ وَاِسْتَبْرَقِ الْجَنَّةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (الحديث) رواه الحاكم وقال: هذا حديث صحيح علي شرط مسلم ووافقه الذهبي:٣٥٤/١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Rafi' (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever, while washing a dead person, conceals the faults (the private parts of the deceased and whatever is on the body of the dead person), his sins are forgiven forty times. Whoever puts the Kafan on the dead person, Allah Ta'ala will clothe him in fine, shimmering silk garments (with gold thread) of Jannah.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ: اَنَّ رَجُلاً زَارَ اَخًا لَهُ فِيْ قَرْيَةٍ اُخْرَي، فَاَرْصَدَ اللهُ لَهُ عَلَي مَدْرَجَتِهِ مَلَكًا، فَلَمَّا اَتَي عَلَيْهِ قَالَ: اَيْنَ تُرِيْدُ؟ قَالَ: اُرِيْدُ اَخًا لِيْ فِيْ هذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ، قَالَ: هَلْ لَكَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ تَرُبُّهَا؟ قَالَ: لَا، غَيْرَ اَنِّيْ اَحْبَبْتُهُ فِي اللهِ ، قَالَ: فَاِنِّيْ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ اِلَيْكَ بِاَنَّ اللهَ قَدْ اَحَبَّكَ كَمَا اَحْبَبْتَهُ فِيْهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب فضل الحب في الله تعالي رقم:٦٥٤٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “A man went to another town to visit his (Muslim) brother. Allah Ta'ala seated an angel on the road he was taking. When the man came near that angel, the angel asked, “Where are you going?' The man said, “I am going to visit a brother of mine in this town.' The angel enquired, ”Are you going to collect something that he owes you?' He replied, “No'! I am going there only because I love him for the sake of Allah Ta'ala.” “Just as you love that brother for the sake of Allah Ta'ala, in the same way Allah Ta'ala loves you; to tell you this, Allah Ta'ala has sent me
